heading: Hi, I'm Ben.
paragraphs: I'm a student studying Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS) and Business @ [UC Berkeley](https://www.berkeley.edu) in the [M.E.T. program](https://met.berkeley.edu).
Before that, I interned at the [Air Force Research Lab](https://www.afrl.af.mil) as a software engineering intern, and at AgentAI as a machine learning intern.
Recently, I won [Gemini 4 Argon Hacks](https://github.com/benjaminxie1/argon-hacks) @ Cerebral Valley and [a16z SpeedHacks](https://github.com/Will-code112223/Speedhacks).
